subject.title: Follow-up: optimize fallback order + add model-input config guardrail

question: Should OpenClaw keep this issue as the broad cost-first fallback policy tracker while `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50287` owns the model-input guardrail subset, or should maintainers reopen/sponsor a narrower fallback-policy item?
rationale: Automation can prove the current source gap, but cannot choose the benchmark policy, capability authority, or whether strict validation should reject existing custom multimodal metadata.

options.title: Keep broad tracker open
options.body: Use this issue for the fallback-order benchmark and policy decision, while keeping the guardrail implementation discussion on `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50287`.

options.title: Reopen narrower fallback tracker
options.body: Reopen or recreate the cost-first fallback optimization tracker and then close this umbrella once both split items are active.

options.title: Defer fallback policy
options.body: Leave configured fallback order as operator intent and only pursue capability diagnostics through the guardrail tracker.

recommendation.title: Keep broad tracker open
recommendation.body: Use this issue for the fallback-order benchmark and policy decision, while keeping the guardrail implementation discussion on `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50287`.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest product-routing signal across the issue timeline plus fallback docs, media-model resolution, and model/fallback history.
